Model Text Summary:
A heartwarming narrative by Ruskin Bond set in the Himalayan foothills of Mussoorie. Six-year-old Rakesh plants a cherry seed in his grandfather's garden. Over four years, the small sapling survives harsh Himalayan weather, being eaten by a goat, cut by a grass-cutter's scythe, and heavy snowfall. Through patient care and shared awe with his grandfather, Rakesh watches it grow into a blossoming, fruit-bearing tree, experiencing the profound joy of nurturing life.
